thread:
maya: CI on main turned red after the merge. integration matrix failing on storage-emulator across py3.10/3.11. Test: StorageEmulatorTest::test_connection_timeout. anyone seen this?
chris: saw one local repro, looks intermittent under load. logs show timeout on connect step.
alex: can we trigger a targeted rerun for the integration matrix only? want to avoid a full image rebuild if possible.
maya: yes — use our rerun wrapper to avoid image builds and preserve artifacts:
```
./scripts/ci rerun --job=matrix:integration --preserve-artifacts --skip-image-build
```
chris: does that preserve the kv cache/artifacts we need for fast startup?
maya: it preserves job workspace and uploaded artifacts. if you need the kv cache preserved, add `--preserve-cache=kv-store`. it won't rebuild container images.
alex: tagging @sre-bot to kick it off.
sre-bot: rerun request received: job=matrix:integration, flags=[preserve-artifacts, preserve-cache=kv-store, skip-image-build], requested_by=alex. queued on runner group "medium-ci". ETA ~2m. :rocket:
chris: fwiw if it fails again, run a quick bisect to narrow commits:
```
./scripts/ci bisect --since HEAD~6 --target StorageEmulatorTest::test_connection_timeout
```
maya: another option to rerun a single matrix axis via GH Actions API (if we need run-level retry):
```
gh api -X POST /repos/:owner/:repo/actions/runs/:run_id/retry -f job_id=12345
```
but prefer the scripts/ci wrapper since it sets the right flags and preserves metadata.
alex: rerun started, watching logs now.
sre-bot: rerun completed: status=success. all matrix axes for integration passed. If this behavior repeats, consider marking test flaky or adding a short retry wrapper in the test harness.
chris: marking test flaky now: `/flaky mark StorageEmulatorTest::test_connection_timeout reason="sporadic timeout on medium runners"` :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks — if it resurfaces we'll follow up with a tiny timeout increase and a diagnostic run on the slow runner type.
